authoring.author: claude-sonnet-5.5 (marnix-faces lane), from strip-labelled.png + 2 zoomed crops

notes: 1876-78 municipal row (B. de Greef): flat bracketed cornice, 3 window axes x 4 storeys, central door, narrow tall stepped gable with finial over the middle axis (crownAt/crownRise/crownSteps/crownFinial), tall two-light windows; pilaster strips at the party walls (not modelled). Brick colour measured from the strip wall (review sheet wall check).
